cover.headline: South Florida is in its drama era

slides.headline: Brightline files for bankruptcy, trains still run
slides.body: Brightline’s Miami-to-Orlando trains will keep running while the companies rework debt in bankruptcy court. So yes, your Orlando plans survive.

slides.headline: New details in MIA shooting arrest
slides.body: Authorities identified the MIA shooting suspect as a 31-year-old homeless man with a prior arrest at LAX. Police say he fired a gun Wednesday.

slides.headline: Hospital escape, carjacking, wild chase
slides.body: A 35-year-old man faced charges after he was accused of escaping a hospital, carjacking and leading a high-speed chase in Miami-Dade.

slides.headline: Fake pay stubs meet Florida’s new rental law
slides.body: Florida’s new law takes on fake pay stubs and rental fraud, with changes for tenants and landlords. Rent applications were already stressful enough.

slides.headline: Ken Griffin’s helipad hits Miami resistance
slides.body: Ken Griffin is running into Miami resistance over a personal helipad. Even billionaire shortcuts can catch a red light down here.

slides.headline: PBSO luxury office bill keeps going
slides.body: Taxpayers are paying for a 6th year of PBSO luxury office space, according to an exclusive. Palm Beach County, your group chat is up.
